How much do I have to pay to get my Scholarship? For the service fee, generally speaking, SICAS will only charge you 10% of the 4 or 3 years of total scholarship amount (there could be a bit difference according to the exact Type of Scholarship that you choose). However, in the beginning , only $300 to $400 need to be paid as a minimum service fee and $75 as application fee to the university at first. When SICAS help you successfully get the scholarship,then the price difference need to be paid. For example: If you get the Undergraduate C Level of Shandong Jiaotong University, The total cost will be: RMB 9000x 4years x 10% =RMB 3600 = USD 600. and since you have paid USD 400, then the price difference: USD 600 - USD 400 = USD 200 need to be paid. Scholarship Guaranteed ? Yes. -After you paid the Scholarship Service Fee as above table listed, SICAS will guarantee you the scholarship! Objectives Objective of the program in Computer Science and Technology aims to provide students with solid theory as well as the latest technological knowledge. Research methods and communication skills are taught while team works are encouraged. After the program, students should be able to engage in high level research and assume leadership role in their respective fields. Duration Duration of the program is 2-2.5 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Computer Application Techniques 2. Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System 3. Computer Software Theory 4. Information Security Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credit units.
